post_meta.author: sierra_wanderer
post_meta.title: Duck Pass 6/9
post_meta.text: Duck 6/9. Snow from about a mile below the pass, continuous but mellow, no traction used just careful steps in the morning crust. Cornice at the top is small and easy to skirt on the left. Duck Lake still half frozen. Mammoth Creek crossings no problem.

post_meta.text: Duck Pass yesterday from Coldwater. Trail is clear the whole way, one tiny snow bank right at the pass that you walk around. Duck Lake outlet is high but rock hoppable. Mosquitoes are the real hazard now, bring your head net.
